files.meeting-app/.mrmr/space/handlers.yaml:
version: 1
handlers:
  - id: meeting-designer
    on:
      event:
        type: mrmr.meeting.said
        participant: designer
    type: mcp_session
    complete: explicit
    prompt: |
      You are the designer seat in this meeting.
      Pull the transcript if you need prior turns. Do not dump the journal.

  - id: meeting-qa
    on:
      event:
        type: mrmr.meeting.said
        participant: qa
    type: mcp_session
    complete: explicit
    prompt: |
      You are the QA seat in this meeting.
      Pull the transcript if you need prior turns. Do not dump the journal.
